_spec: Spec 049 AC #18 — single source of truth for USD cost conversion of Gate-4 visual-UAT vision calls. Read by stagehand-runner (Node side) + cabinet/scripts/lib/model-pricing.sh.
_source: Published Anthropic pricing (anthropic.com/pricing + console.anthropic.com). NO live validation (M4: no machine-readable pricing API; a scrape on the hot path was itself the drift it claimed to prevent). Drift is caught ONLY by the staleness assertion below — refresh manually when WARN fires.
_verify_on_refresh: Re-confirm every rate against console.anthropic.com billing before bumping pricing_as_of. Rates below are best-known as of pricing_as_of and are intentionally treated as stale-able.

cache_multipliers._comment: Applied to the model's INPUT rate. Anthropic-uniform across current models. write_1h is the 1h-TTL cache-write surcharge (the Cabinet runs ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H); write_5m is the default 5m TTL.
